proposals.reason: The switch expression is the index of a loop bounded to the 49 explicitly handled configuration keywords.
proposals.evidence: The switch is reached only when strcmp matches od_config_text[wCurrent] inside for(wCurrent = 0; wCurrent < TEXT_SIZE; ++wCurrent). TEXT_SIZE is 49 and the switch contains cases 0 through 48, so its implicit default cannot be selected.

proposals.reason: The line-array capacity advances from zero only in exact LINE_ARRAY_GROW_SIZE increments, so exercising this guard requires constructing and indexing nearly UINT_MAX lines.
proposals.evidence: unProcessingLine starts at zero and growth occurs only when it equals unLineArraySize; each successful growth adds 20. Modern UINT widths require billions of indexed lines. With 16-bit UINT, the pointer array reaches the 16-bit size_t allocation limit well before the 65,520-line capacity that would make this guard true.

proposals.reason: A single-threaded isolated test cannot both enter the empty UART wait with a null idle callback and later make the queue nonempty so the function returns.
proposals.evidence: The callback-present path is exercised with the callback supplying the byte, and the callback-null configuration is exercised when a byte is already queued. Entering the loop with both an empty queue and no callback has no operation capable of changing nRXChars and therefore cannot terminate without an external interrupt producer.

proposals.reason: A single-threaded isolated test cannot fill the UART queue, enter the remaining-data path with a null idle callback, and subsequently free queue space so the function terminates.
proposals.evidence: The callback-present path is exercised with a callback that drains the queue, and callback-null operation is exercised when the complete buffer fits in the queue. With remaining data, a full queue, and no callback or external UART interrupt producer, the loop has no operation that can create space.

proposals.reason: No failure operation follows successful creation of the up-down control.
proposals.evidence: Every failure before line 381 leaves hwndTimeUpDown null. Once CreateWindowEx returns a non-null up-down handle, the remaining operations are unchecked setters, bSuccess is set true, and cleanup is skipped. All reachable creation-failure stages and the successful path are exercised.
